deep_dive.title: Handbook of Error-Correcting Codes
deep_dive.abstract: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This handbook presents a curated reference of error-correcting codes for both classical and quantum information, including classification and relations among codes, serving as a rigorous reference for the field.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 本手册基于纠错动物园数据库，提供了对经典和量子纠错码的全面参考，包含编码分类、符号类型以及编码间关系，覆盖球堆积、格、设计、群和量子物质相。它不仅是一份严谨的参考文献，也是探索编码关联和发现新联系的实用工具，对量子纠错编码研究具有重要参考价值。

deep_dive.matched_query_text: Papers central to 量子纠错编码相关论文，包括qLDPC code、surface code等与编码理论相关的, especially work that connects or combines: surface code quantum error correction; topological codes like surface code and color code for error correction; threshold analysis of quantum error correcting codes; stabilizer codes and their application in quantum error correction; quantum low-density parity-check code; concatenated quantum error-correcting code; recent advances in qLDPC codes for quantum error correction; comparison of surface code and qLDPC code performance; comparison of different quantum error correcting codes; advances in topological quantum error correction.
